title: Coordination agent execution-mechanics state
description: Per-agent state.json. Records DISPATCH MECHANICS ONLY, never project/task status (that is execution_plan.md). See automation-proposal.md sections 4-6.

model.description: Current executor; switchable without changing identity

dispatch_sequence.description: Matches the current track.md row number; 0 = never dispatched

task_digest.description: SHA-256 of the current task.md bytes; a changed digest invalidates a stale claim

status.description: Dispatch mechanics only. 'blocked' = a dispatch dependency, NOT the persistent-goal status.

run_id.description: Active run/session identifier, or null when idle

owned_write_targets.description: Files/schema this agent exclusively writes this dispatch (must be disjoint across agents)

canonical_task_ids.description: SEQ/Task IDs the current task.md addresses (for the monitor; status still read from execution_plan.md)

claim.description: Atomic dispatch claim. Only one process may hold a (dispatch_sequence, task_digest) claim.

fence.description: Monotonic fence token; completion is accepted only from the current fence (dispatch_core)

heartbeat_utc.description: Last heartbeat; a stale heartbeat + expired lease = orphan (watchdog.py)

lease_expires_utc.description: After this, a stale-run sweep may reclaim

baseline_ref.description: Provenance id of the captured uncommitted-dependency baseline (baseline.py)

learning_present.description: task.md carries the Read-alongside learning block (P1-b)

checkpoint.description: Last context-compaction checkpoint. At a checkpoint the worker writes context.md/As-built and the next dispatch resumes a FRESH, compact session.

resumed_from.description: context.md handoff the fresh session resumed from

updated_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the last state write
